subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the migration delete them on first config write?
rationale: This changes a shipped recovery mechanism for sensitive config files, so maintainers need to choose the upgrade contract before the PR can be safely merged.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require the PR to keep existing `.bak.N` recovery points until timestamped backups replace them, or convert them into the new bounded retention set.

options.title: Accept First-Run Pruning
options.body: Allow the new scheme to delete legacy numbered backups immediately and document that as an intentional upgrade tradeoff.

options.title: Defer Timestamp Naming
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the current numbered ring until a broader backup layout decision is ready.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require the PR to keep existing `.bak.N` recovery points until timestamped backups replace them, or convert them into the new bounded retention set.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config recovery documentation and issue review history make steipete the best available owner for the backup migration policy choice.
